name: Frozen Tomb
description: On an enemy in either row: Freeze 2 turns, no damage (bosses take Chill, as the status rules say). On an ally instead: encased, immune to all damage until their next turn, then Chill 1 turn.

effects.note: the sheet says bosses Freeze 1; the rulebook’s status table (03 §3.5, the owner) makes a boss take Chill instead, so the status’s bossBecomes rules
when the chosen target is an ally the skill’s other lines are skipped; the ally is immune to all damage until its next turn, then gets `status` 1 (no status when omitted)

mastery.text: An encased ally keeps no Chill.
